producersOf: SELECT content_cid, item_cid, collection_cid, completion_cid, filename FROM producer WHERE content_cid = ?
latestSuccessfulRun: SELECT completion_cid FROM run WHERE pipeline = ? AND status = 'succeeded' AND possibly_incomplete = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim_current cc JOIN claim k ON k.claim_cid = cc.claim_cid WHERE cc.subject_cid = run.completion_cid AND cc.attribute IS NULL AND k.verb = 'delete') ORDER BY finished_at DESC, completion_cid ASC LIMIT 1
itemsBase: SELECT ci.item_cid, ci.collection_cid FROM collection_item ci JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = ci.collection_cid WHERE c.completion_cid = ? AND c.output_name = ?
itemsPredicate: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_attr a WHERE a.item_cid = ci.item_cid AND a.truncated = 0 AND a.path = ? AND a.type = ? AND a.value = ?)
itemsPredicateNull: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_attr a WHERE a.item_cid = ci.item_cid AND a.truncated = 0 AND a.path = ? AND a.type = ? AND a.value IS NULL)

itemsRange.>=: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_attr a WHERE a.item_cid = ci.item_cid AND a.truncated = 0 AND a.path = ? AND a.type IN ('int', 'float') AND CAST(a.value AS REAL) >= ?)
itemsRange.<=: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_attr a WHERE a.item_cid = ci.item_cid AND a.truncated = 0 AND a.path = ? AND a.type IN ('int', 'float') AND CAST(a.value AS REAL) <= ?)
itemsRange.>: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_attr a WHERE a.item_cid = ci.item_cid AND a.truncated = 0 AND a.path = ? AND a.type IN ('int', 'float') AND CAST(a.value AS REAL) > ?)
itemsRange.<: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_attr a WHERE a.item_cid = ci.item_cid AND a.truncated = 0 AND a.path = ? AND a.type IN ('int', 'float') AND CAST(a.value AS REAL) < ?)

itemsNotEqual: AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_attr a WHERE a.item_cid = ci.item_cid AND a.truncated = 0 AND a.path = ? AND a.type = ? AND a.value = ?)
collectionsOf: SELECT output_name, collection_cid FROM collection WHERE completion_cid = ? ORDER BY output_name
watermark: SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'store_log_watermark'
pipelines: SELECT pipeline, count(*) AS runs, max(finished_at) AS latest FROM run GROUP BY pipeline ORDER BY pipeline
runsOfPipeline: SELECT completion_cid, manifest_cid, pipeline, run_name, asserted_by, status, possibly_incomplete, finished_at FROM run WHERE pipeline = ? ORDER BY finished_at DESC, completion_cid ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
runsOfPipelineBy: SELECT completion_cid, manifest_cid, pipeline, run_name, asserted_by, status, possibly_incomplete, finished_at FROM run WHERE pipeline = ? AND lower(trim(asserted_by, char(32,9,10,13,12,11))) = lower(trim(?, char(32,9,10,13,12,11))) ORDER BY finished_at DESC, completion_cid ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
runByCompletion: SELECT completion_cid, manifest_cid, pipeline, run_name, nf_run_hash, status, possibly_incomplete, finished_at FROM run WHERE completion_cid = ?
runsKnown: SELECT completion_cid FROM run WHERE completion_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
collectionByCid: SELECT collection_cid, completion_cid, output_name FROM collection WHERE collection_cid = ?
collectionItems: SELECT item_cid FROM collection_item WHERE collection_cid = ? ORDER BY item_cid LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
collectionAllItems: SELECT item_cid FROM collection_item WHERE collection_cid = ? ORDER BY item_cid
runCount: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM run WHERE pipeline = ?
runCountBy: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM run WHERE pipeline = ? AND lower(trim(asserted_by, char(32,9,10,13,12,11))) = lower(trim(?, char(32,9,10,13,12,11)))
collectionItemCount: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM collection_item WHERE collection_cid = ?
selectionsKnown: SELECT collection_cid FROM collection WHERE collection_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND kind = 'selection'
claimsKnown: SELECT claim_cid FROM claim WHERE claim_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
claimsOf: SELECT claim_cid, subject_cid, verb, attribute, value, timestamp, asserted_by FROM claim WHERE subject_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
supersedesOf: SELECT claim_cid, superseded_cid FROM claim_supersedes WHERE superseded_cid IN (SELECT claim_cid FROM claim WHERE subject_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))
selectionsPage: SELECT l.cid AS selection_cid, l.written_at, c.asserted_by FROM log_entry l JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = l.cid WHERE l.kind = 'selection' ORDER BY l.written_at DESC, l.cid ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
selectionsPageBy: SELECT l.cid AS selection_cid, l.written_at, c.asserted_by FROM log_entry l JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = l.cid WHERE l.kind = 'selection' AND lower(trim(c.asserted_by, char(32,9,10,13,12,11))) = lower(trim(?, char(32,9,10,13,12,11))) ORDER BY l.written_at DESC, l.cid ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
selectionCount: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM log_entry WHERE kind = 'selection'
selectionCountBy: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM log_entry l JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = l.cid WHERE l.kind = 'selection' AND lower(trim(c.asserted_by, char(32,9,10,13,12,11))) = lower(trim(?, char(32,9,10,13,12,11)))
firstSeen: SELECT written_at FROM log_entry WHERE cid = ? ORDER BY written_at LIMIT 1
selectionsHolding: SELECT DISTINCT ci.collection_cid FROM collection_item ci JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = ci.collection_cid WHERE ci.item_cid = ? AND c.kind = 'selection' ORDER BY ci.collection_cid
successfulRunsPage: SELECT completion_cid, finished_at FROM run WHERE pipeline = ? AND status = 'succeeded' AND possibly_incomplete = 0 ORDER BY finished_at DESC, completion_cid ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
searchSampleValues: SELECT DISTINCT value FROM item_attr WHERE path IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND type = 'string' AND value >= ? AND value < ? LIMIT ?
searchSampleRows: SELECT a.value AS sample, a.path, a.item_cid, c.collection_cid, c.output_name, r.completion_cid, r.run_name, r.pipeline, r.status, r.possibly_incomplete, r.finished_at FROM item_attr a JOIN collection_item ci ON ci.item_cid = a.item_cid JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = ci.collection_cid JOIN run r ON r.completion_cid = c.completion_cid WHERE a.path IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND a.type = 'string' AND a.value = ? AND a.truncated = 0 AND c.kind = 'output' ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC, r.completion_cid, a.item_cid, c.collection_cid, a.path LIMIT ?
searchRunCids: SELECT completion_cid, run_name, pipeline, status, possibly_incomplete, finished_at FROM run WHERE completion_cid >= ? AND completion_cid < ? ORDER BY completion_cid LIMIT ?
searchCollectionCids: SELECT c.collection_cid, c.kind, c.output_name, c.completion_cid, r.run_name FROM collection c LEFT JOIN run r ON r.completion_cid = c.completion_cid WHERE c.collection_cid >= ? AND c.collection_cid < ? ORDER BY c.collection_cid LIMIT ?
searchItemCids: SELECT ci.item_cid, ci.collection_cid, c.kind, c.output_name FROM collection_item ci JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = ci.collection_cid WHERE ci.item_cid >= ? AND ci.item_cid < ? ORDER BY ci.item_cid, c.kind, ci.collection_cid LIMIT ?
searchContentCids: SELECT content_cid, min(filename) AS filename FROM producer WHERE content_cid >= ? AND content_cid < ? GROUP BY content_cid ORDER BY content_cid LIMIT ?
storeStats: SELECT stored_bytes, stored_blocks, referenced_bytes, pinned_bytes, held_bytes, releasing_bytes, shared_bytes, partial FROM store_stats
snapshotGrace: SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'sweep_grace_ms'
storageOmitted: SELECT key, value FROM meta WHERE key IN ('storage_omitted', 'snapshot_max_bytes')
asserterStats: SELECT asserted_by, reachable_bytes, exclusive_bytes, pinned_bytes, releasing_bytes FROM asserter_stats ORDER BY reachable_bytes DESC, asserted_by ASC
storageRuns: SELECT o.id, o.cid, o.state, o.since, r.run_name, r.pipeline, r.status, r.finished_at, s.reachable_bytes, s.reachable_blocks, s.exclusive_bytes, s.pinned_bytes, s.partial FROM run r CROSS JOIN root o ON o.cid = r.completion_cid AND o.kind = 'run' JOIN root_stats s ON s.root_id = o.id ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC, r.completion_cid ASC
rootsOf: SELECT o.id, o.kind, o.asserted_by, o.state, o.since, s.reachable_bytes, s.reachable_blocks, s.exclusive_bytes, s.pinned_bytes, s.partial FROM root o JOIN root_stats s ON s.root_id = o.id WHERE o.cid = ? ORDER BY o.id
rootShared: SELECT x.id, x.cid, x.kind, x.asserted_by, r.run_name, ho.template, ho.selection_cid, sh.bytes FROM root_shared sh JOIN root x ON x.id = sh.other_root_id LEFT JOIN run r ON r.completion_cid = x.cid AND x.kind = 'run' LEFT JOIN handoff ho ON ho.cid = x.cid AND x.kind = 'handoff' WHERE sh.root_id = ? ORDER BY sh.bytes DESC, x.cid ASC, x.id ASC
pinnedOverlapOf: SELECT asserted_by, bytes FROM pinned_overlap WHERE subject_cid = ? ORDER BY bytes DESC, asserted_by ASC
kindStats: SELECT kind, files, bytes FROM kind_stats ORDER BY bytes DESC, kind ASC
pipelineStats: SELECT pipeline, runs, bytes, blocks, releasing_bytes, (SELECT partial FROM store_stats) AS partial FROM pipeline_stats
collectionSize: SELECT bytes, blocks FROM collection_size WHERE collection_cid = ?
itemSize: SELECT bytes, blocks FROM item_size WHERE item_cid = ?
pinRoots: SELECT o.id, o.cid, o.asserted_by, o.since, s.reachable_bytes, s.exclusive_bytes, r.completion_cid AS run_cid, r.run_name, c.collection_cid, c.kind AS collection_kind, i.item_cid, CASE WHEN i.item_cid IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT ci.collection_cid FROM collection_item ci WHERE ci.item_cid = o.cid ORDER BY ci.collection_cid LIMIT 1) END AS item_collection FROM root o JOIN root_stats s ON s.root_id = o.id LEFT JOIN run r ON r.completion_cid = o.cid LEFT JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = o.cid LEFT JOIN item i ON i.item_cid = o.cid WHERE o.kind = 'pin' ORDER BY o.since DESC, o.id DESC
transfersKnown: SELECT cid FROM transfer WHERE cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
transfersOf: SELECT t.cid, t.from_member, t.to_member, t.asserted_by, t.depth, t.claims, t.blocks, t.copied, t.bytes, t.at FROM transfer t WHERE t.cid IN (SELECT transfer_cid FROM transfer_root WHERE root_cid = ?) ORDER BY t.at DESC, t.cid ASC
projectsKnown: SELECT project_cid FROM project WHERE project_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
projects: SELECT project_cid, name, description, created_by, created_at FROM project
projectByCid: SELECT project_cid, name, description, created_by, created_at FROM project WHERE project_cid = ?
projectStats: SELECT reachable_bytes, pinned_bytes, held_bytes, releasing_bytes, roots FROM project_stats WHERE project_cid = ?
projectStatsOf: SELECT project_cid, reachable_bytes, pinned_bytes, held_bytes, releasing_bytes, roots FROM project_stats WHERE project_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
projectMemberSubjects: SELECT DISTINCT subject_cid FROM claim_current WHERE attribute = 'project' AND value = ?
projectMembershipSubjects: SELECT DISTINCT subject_cid FROM claim_current WHERE attribute = 'project' AND value IS NOT NULL
projectRemovedSubjects: SELECT DISTINCT subject_cid FROM claim_current WHERE attribute = 'project' AND value IS NULL
itemCollectionsOf: SELECT ci.item_cid, ci.collection_cid FROM collection_item ci JOIN collection c ON c.collection_cid = ci.collection_cid WHERE ci.item_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND c.kind = 'output' ORDER BY ci.item_cid, ci.collection_cid
subjectKinds: SELECT completion_cid AS cid, 'run' AS kind FROM run WHERE completion_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) UNION ALL SELECT collection_cid, 'selection' FROM collection WHERE collection_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND kind = 'selection' UNION ALL SELECT item_cid, 'item' FROM item WHERE item_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
runInputsOf: SELECT completion_cid, role, name, address, size, sample FROM run_input WHERE completion_cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY completion_cid, role, name, address
sharedInputRows: SELECT completion_cid, role, name, address, size, sample FROM run_input WHERE role = 'task' AND sample IS NOT NULL AND address IN (SELECT address FROM run_input WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND role = 'task' GROUP BY address HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT completion_cid) > 1) ORDER BY address, completion_cid
handoffsKnown: SELECT cid FROM handoff WHERE cid IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
handoffs: SELECT cid, template, selection_cid, project_cid, asserted_by, at FROM handoff ORDER BY at DESC, cid ASC
